title: CHEP-1.0 deterministic coding-harness evaluation matrix
description: Strict structural schema for the preregistered provider-neutral coding-harness matrix. Cross-record cardinality, referential integrity, deterministic allocation, and hash recomputation are mandatory semantic-validator checks listed in semantic_invariants.

matrix_payload_sha256.description: SHA-256 of RFC 8785 JCS for the matrix with this property omitted.
